state.background: Review the current Plan42 scope decision for P42-316/P42-317 after reading the exact checkpoint text, ledger rows, broader plan matrix references, and relevant E2E implementation. The decision is to retain P42-316 `expect(legendButton).toBeVisible()` and P42-317 computed swatch color comparison in Playwright. The test parses the current `--series-9` hex from globals.css, converts it to RGB, navigates the app, selects the exact `教養娯楽` legend, reads its rendered swatch `getComputedStyle(...).backgroundColor`, and compares it to the live source token value. This exercises runtime CSS variable resolution/cascade/theme and current compiled styling; a static unit contract or hardcoded `#7e4a00` would not prove those browser behaviors and would duplicate source-literal mapping without making the E2E assertions removable. P42-320+ dark-mode full palette stays later scope. There are no source/test edits requested; this is a plan/ledger decision only. One broader plan matrix entry still says token/source mapping `can move to proposed tests/components/LegendColorContract.test.tsx`; the new checkpoint and P42-316/317 ledger rows say not to add that unit test. Assess whether this is compatible as a candidate possibility or is a contradictory active instruction that needs reconciliation.
acceptanceCriteria: The plan justifies keeping P42-316 legend visibility and P42-317 computed color parity in Playwright because the relevant contract includes rendered, theme/cascade-resolved styling that a unit test cannot establish.

The E2E derives expected color dynamically from current CSS `--series-9` rather than hardcoding `#7e4a00`, so valid token changes do not require updating a test literal and stale built CSS is detected.
No proposed `LegendColorContract` test is added when it would only duplicate static source/token mapping and could not replace P42-317's browser computed-style evidence.
P42-320+ dark mode remains explicitly outside this decision's current scope.
The implementation checkpoint and exact ledger rows P42-316/P42-317 clearly state the retention decision and browser rationale.

All active summaries/appendices in the plan agree with the new decision; specifically evaluate the broader legend-color-sync matrix entry that says token/source mapping can move to a proposed LegendColorContract test. If it is merely a future candidate, that distinction should be unambiguous; if not, identify required correction.
